# Berkshire Hathaway Annual Net Income Investigation

**Insufficient evidence**

BRK-B revenue for the fiscal period ended 2024-12-31 was $371.433 billion [E6e10011bb6](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1067983/000095017025025210/0000950170-25-025210-index.html), up from $364.482 billion for 2023-12-31 [E1e9719d98d](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1067983/000095017024019719/0000950170-24-019719-index.html). BRK-B net income for the fiscal period ended 2024-12-31 was $88.995 billion [Ed554d9e5dd](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1067983/000095017025025210/0000950170-25-025210-index.html), down from $96.223 billion for 2023-12-31 [E46eb47805b](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1067983/000095017024019719/0000950170-24-019719-index.html). BRK-B cash PP&E purchases for the fiscal period ended 2024-12-31 was $18.976 billion [Eda18b9f722](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1067983/000095017025025210/0000950170-25-025210-index.html), down from $19.409 billion for 2023-12-31 [E8c5626e52b](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1067983/000095017024019719/0000950170-24-019719-index.html).

## What was knowable then

As of the March 1, 2023, as-of date, Berkshire Hathaway had reported 2022 annual revenues of $302,089,000,000 and a net loss of $22,819,000,000 [Eb9d9654119](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1067983/000095017023004451/0000950170-23-004451-index.html) [Ea3f5d442c0](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1067983/000095017023004451/0000950170-23-004451-index.html). Management provided qualitative commentary regarding specific reporting units like Forest River and GEICO, along with estimates of maximum gross losses under retroactive reinsurance policies [E0539f6d652](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1067983/000095017023004451/brka-20221231.htm) [E45a8f46e7f](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1067983/000095017023004451/brka-20221231.htm) [E9b80b20fbf](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1067983/000095017023004451/brka-20221231.htm).

## What happened later

In subsequent annual filings, Berkshire Hathaway reported consolidated net income of $96,223,000,000 for the fiscal year ended December 31, 2023, and $88,995,000,000 for the fiscal year ended December 31, 2024 [E46eb47805b](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1067983/000095017024019719/0000950170-24-019719-index.html) [Ed554d9e5dd](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1067983/000095017025025210/0000950170-25-025210-index.html). Consolidated revenues were $364,482,000,000 for the fiscal year ended December 31, 2023, and $371,433,000,000 for the fiscal year ended December 31, 2024 [E1e9719d98d](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1067983/000095017024019719/0000950170-24-019719-index.html) [E6e10011bb6](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1067983/000095017025025210/0000950170-25-025210-index.html).

## The peer test

Only BRK-B was selected. Add a peer company to compare results.

## Cross-examination

Distinguishing whole-company financial facts from management outlooks shows that consolidated net income figures are verified by XBRL-tagged financial statements, whereas segment statements (such as Forest River demand forecasts or GEICO underwriting expectations) remain qualitative and unverified by whole-company metrics [E0539f6d652](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1067983/000095017023004451/brka-20221231.htm) [E45a8f46e7f](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1067983/000095017023004451/brka-20221231.htm). Investors should ask how management plans to reconcile volatile investment gains and losses with consistent core operating earnings in future periods.

## Limits

- Segment-level financial metrics for Forest River and GEICO were not retrieved under supported XBRL tags.
- Macroeconomic vintages are classified as hindsight context and excluded from the historical knowledge room.
- The financial comparison may be informative, but no retrieved management claim was linked to testable outcomes. The overall claim verdict is therefore insufficient evidence.
